name: gravity
description: Find your software's gravity. Turn architectural forces into principles and constraints through a focused interview.

interface.shortDescription: Find the forces that shape your software architecture
interface.longDescription: A bridge must answer to gravity. What must your software answer to? Gravity brings the discipline of engineering under physical constraints to software architecture: uncover the forces that matter, challenge trade-offs, and establish principles and constraints grounded in your system.
defaultPrompt: Use $gravity to define architecture principles and constraints.
